audits.claim: A temporarily SMS-locked user or team can permanently lose a future reminder after two skipped scheduling attempts.
audits.evidence: An unscheduled SMS with a future scheduledDate within seven days and retryCount 0 is selected at packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleSMSReminders.ts:48-60; with configured Twilio credentials and a locked owner, twilioProvider.ts:88-95 returns undefined before scheduling. The lock is repository-defined state checked at packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/providers/twilioProvider.ts:144-181, and scheduleSMSReminders.ts:178-186 increments its retryCount on each such skip. After two runs it is 2, so the next run deletes the row at :29-45 even if its scheduledDate is still in the future, including if the owner was unlocked just before that run. Unlocking is supported by packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/admin/setSMSLockState.handler.ts:18-25 and :52-59, but cannot restore the deleted reminder; the locked branch logs a debug message at twilioProvider.ts:93, so the finding's literal no-log claim is overstated although deletion itself has no log.
